wqformat

Source: vignettes/wqformat.Rmd
wqformat.Rmd

Overview

The wqformat R package converts water quality data to several different formats. It is primarily designed to format water quality data for MassWateR and WQdashboard, but it can convert data to other formats as well.

The package is created in collaboration with the Massachusetts Bays National Estuary Partnership with funding from an EPA Exchange Network Grant (Grant No. ).

Package Installation

Install the package as follows:

library(wqformat)

Data Inputs

wqformat accepts two types of data: water quality results and site metadata. Before using wqformat, please double check that all columns and variables are spelled correctly; wqformat provides informative error messages, but will not work correctly if things are misspelled.

wqformat will:

  • Rename columns
  • Update variable names

wqformat will not:

  • Check for QAQC errors

Converting Standard Formats

By default, wqformat accepts eight different formats, listed below. Converting data between accepted formats is a simple process: use format_results() to format water quality results and format_sites() to format site metadata. These functions will update column names, update variable names, and standardize units.

Accepted Formats
Format Code Water Quality Results Site Metadata
Blackstone River Coalition MA_BRC x x
Friends of Casco Bay ME_FOCB x x
Maine DEP ME_DEP x
MassWateR MassWateR x x
Rhode Island DEM RI_DEM x
URI Watershed Watch RI_WW x x
wqdashboard wqdashboard x x
WQX WQX x x

To format result data for MassWateR or WQdashboard, you may use format_mwr_results() or format_wqd_results() respectively.

Converting Custom Formats

wqformat includes a series of helper functions to convert data to or from a custom format.

Update Columns

To adjust column names, use rename_col() or concat_col().

To change a column type, use col_to_numeric(), col_to_date(), or col_to_time().

Update Variables

To update the variables within a column, use update_var(). To check for typos or other errors, use warn_invalid_var().

If a column contains state names, use state_to_abb() or abb_to_state() to format all states as abbreviations or full names respectively.

Update Units

To convert all values in a column to a unit of your choice, use set_units().

To standardize units within a parameter type or other group, use standardize_units() or standardize_units_across().
